text: Thank you for the history; could you describe the specific nature of your gait and limb ataxia, and when these symptoms first began? Are they constant or do they fluctuate with activity or rest?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Are these symptoms constant, or do they fluctuate with rest and activity? Additionally, have you experienced any vision changes, difficulty swallowing, or changes in your handwriting?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your history of Crohn's disease and use of natalizumab, which increases the risk for JC virus reactivation, have you noticed any recent changes in your vision, such as blurriness, or any new cognitive issues like memory loss or personality changes?
